title: 2026 NAEI GHG data publication and vintage QA controls

sources.title: UK Greenhouse Gas Inventory 1990 to 2024 annual report

facts.source_fact: The 2026 UK Greenhouse Gas Inventory publication covers the 1990 to 2024 time series.
facts.expected_handling: Attach inventory publication year and time-series endpoint.

facts.source_fact: The NAEI catalogue lists the next publication of the 2026 National Inventory Document for April 2027.
facts.expected_handling: Treat future publication dates as schedules rather than available data.

facts.source_fact: A 2026 UK greenhouse-gas pivot table by source is listed in the NAEI data catalogue.
facts.expected_handling: Keep source-based table semantics separate from end-user views.

facts.source_fact: The next publication date for the 2026 source pivot table is listed as March 2027.
facts.expected_handling: Mark future update status explicitly.

facts.source_fact: The 2026 devolved-administration GHG inventories cover England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland for 1990 to 2024.
facts.expected_handling: Keep geography identity with devolved inventory values.

facts.source_fact: The next publication for the 1990-2024 devolved inventories is listed for 2027.
facts.expected_handling: Do not claim an unpublished next edition.

facts.source_fact: The catalogue lists emissions from point sources for 2005 to 2023 with a Summer 2026 publication timetable.
facts.expected_handling: Attach point-source dataset vintage and coverage years.

facts.source_fact: The catalogue lists gridded emissions data for 2005 to 2023 with a Summer 2026 publication timetable.
facts.expected_handling: Keep gridded estimates distinct from point-source or parcel measurements.

facts.source_fact: An interactive UK emissions map for 2023 is listed with a Summer 2026 timetable.
facts.expected_handling: Attach map reference year to visualised values.

facts.source_fact: An interactive Local Authority GHG map for 2005 to 2023 is listed with a Summer 2026 timetable.
facts.expected_handling: Keep local-authority geography distinct from parcels.

facts.source_fact: NAEI provides a data archive for previous versions of published GHG datasets.
facts.expected_handling: Use archived-version provenance when comparing historical releases.

facts.source_fact: The Greenhouse Gas Emissions Data catalogue was last updated on 9 June 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Attach catalogue-vintage date to availability statements.

facts.source_fact: The UK Greenhouse Gas Inventory 1990 to 2024 annual report is dated 30 April 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Use report date as publication provenance.

facts.source_fact: The annual report is prepared for submission under the Framework Convention on Climate Change.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve international-reporting context.

facts.source_fact: The 1990-2024 inventory publication includes annex materials alongside the main report.
facts.expected_handling: Keep annex provenance for detailed methods and tables.

facts.source_fact: Energy background data are published as additional material with the inventory report.
facts.expected_handling: Link energy-input evidence to the applicable inventory edition.

facts.source_fact: A supplementary file provides emission-factor information for the agriculture sector.
facts.expected_handling: Use sector-specific factor provenance for agriculture estimates.

facts.source_fact: Forest-land stratification material is provided as supplementary inventory documentation.
facts.expected_handling: Carry land-category method provenance with relevant estimates.

facts.source_fact: The catalogue's publication year is distinct from the latest emissions year covered by a dataset.
facts.expected_handling: Store publication year and data-year range separately.

facts.source_fact: NAEI publishes inventories, pivot tables, point-source datasets, gridded datasets and interactive maps with different semantics.
facts.expected_handling: Require dataset-type identity before comparing values.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve dataset title, coverage and availability status.
Attach dataset type, geography and reporting basis.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents mixing national, devolved, point-source and gridded data.

guard_patterns.handling: Attach publication year, data-year range and next-publication status.
Carry NAEI report, annex and supplementary-data provenance.
Do not treat NAEI point-source, grid or map data as parcel-level measured emissions without separate binding.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; control_id={package_id}_{fact_id}_{pattern_id}; each generated row inherits confidence_percent=99 and verification=PASS
